checks: 测试原件及项目状态确实写入服务器磁盘
双重确认后项目目录及原件被物理移除
删除后项目、原件下载和成果导出均返回 404
所有已有项目的业务资料校验摘要保持一致
scope: Confirmed deletion removes the selected project storage, snapshots and preview cache. Existing exported files, independent operational backups and system project-management logs remain. Legacy soft-deleted projects are not automatically purged.
